summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Agriculture to create a grant program for specialty crop producers to acquire and receive training on automated and mechanized equipment, such as sorting machines, drones, and robotic systems, with recipients required to provide matching funds.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a new grant program for specialty crop producers, which will involve federal funds being awarded. This directly increases government spending.

The bill creates a new federal grant program for specialty crop automation equipment and training, authorizing USDA spending with no offsets, revenue increases, or spending cuts specified. This directly adds to federal outlays to fund agricultural priorities, pushing toward acceptance of a larger deficit.
